playTags.note: Play Console > Store settings > Manage tags. Pick up to 5 from Play's own tag list; these are intents in priority order. Match each to the nearest tag name the console offers (names vary), and skip any with no close match.

contact.phoneNote: Optional on both stores. The number +20 111 142 4312 is unconfirmed; leave empty unless the Foundation confirms it.
contact.playAddress: «[يُستكمل: العنوان القانوني للمؤسسة — يظهر علنًا في Play إن كانت المؤسسة تاجرًا]»

appStore.exclusionReason: China mainland requires an ICP filing number for new apps (MIIT rule enforced by Apple since 2023-2024); the Foundation has none. Hong Kong (HK), Macao (MO) and Taiwan (TW) stay included.
appStore.storeControlled: Apple itself does not operate the App Store in sanctioned territories (e.g. Iran, Syria, North Korea, Cuba); those cannot be ticked and need no action.

play.storeControlled: Google Play does not distribute in sanctioned regions (e.g. Iran, Syria, North Korea, Cuba, Crimea); the console does not offer them. Nothing to exclude manually.

gccMenaConfirmedIncluded.PS: Palestinian Territories (Play lists it; confirm whether App Store Connect offers it as a storefront and tick it if so)

gccMenaStoreControlled.SY: Syria: sanctioned; neither store distributes there, nothing to configure
gccMenaStoreControlled.IR: Iran: sanctioned; neither store distributes there

availability.verify: Before submitting, open each store's availability page and confirm every code in gccMenaConfirmedIncluded is ticked; storefront lists change.

euDigitalServicesAct.note: Both stores block EU distribution until this is declared. A trader must publish a verified address, phone and email on the listing; a non-trader (non-commercial, free, no ads, no IAP) declares none. The Foundation decides with counsel; if 'trader', contact.playAddress and a public phone/email become mandatory.
